title: GitHub Repository Health Analyzer Input
description: Configure GitHub repository URLs, authentication token, scanning depth, and proxy settings.

startUrls.title: Repositories or Users to Scan
startUrls.description: Enter GitHub Repository URLs (e.g. https://github.com/facebook/react) or User/Organization Profile URLs (e.g. https://github.com/apify) to scan public repositories.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Specify direct repository URLs or GitHub user/organization profiles to scan.

maxReposPerUser.title: Max Repositories per Profile
maxReposPerUser.description: Maximum number of public repositories to audit when scanning a user or organization profile URL. Set to 0 for unlimited.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT)
githubToken.description: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token (classic or fine-grained). Increases rate limits from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour and unlocks private repository scanning.
githubToken.sectionDescription: Supply a personal access token for enterprise repos and elevated API rate limits.

minHealthScore.title: Minimum Health Score Filter
minHealthScore.description: Filter results to only output repositories scoring at or above this threshold (0-100). Set to 0 to keep all results.
minHealthScore.sectionDescription: Fine-tune audit depth and output filtering thresholds.

maxCommitHistory.title: Max Commits to Analyze
maxCommitHistory.description: Maximum recent commit records to fetch and analyze for activity heatmaps, commit velocity, and author timelines.

maxIssuesAndPrs.title: Max Issues & PRs Sample Size
maxIssuesAndPrs.description: Number of open and closed issues and pull requests to sample for aging distribution and merge velocity calculation.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select Apify Proxy or custom proxies to route GitHub API requests reliably across restricted networks.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Route requests through Apify Proxy when running large-scale crawls across networks.
